content:
（葡萄牙文）

Muirity 是一種新的礦石，旨在擴展《我的世界》中物品的進化路線。長久以來，石頭、鐵、金、鑽石和下界合金的階層已經顯得過時，而 Muirity 正是為《我的世界》帶來的新進化階層。這是一種超級強大的礦石，擁有多個進化等級。

 

背景故事：掠奪者為了嘗試開啟通往地獄的傳送門而進行了一場魔法儀式，隨後一股魔法力量散播至全世界。這股力量消散於岩石之中，形成了 Muirity 礦石。儘管這是一種強大的礦石，但它也可能非常危險。

 

（英文）

Muirity is a new ore to expand the evolution of items in Minecraft, always stone, iron, gold, diamond and netherite is already outdated, Muirity is the new evolution tier for Minecraft, a super powerful ore that has several levels of evolution

 Background story: after a magical ritual performed by the pillagers to try to create a portal to the nether, a magical power spread throughout the world, this power dissipated into stones forming the Muirity ore, despite being a powerful ore it can be very dangerous.
（由 Google 翻譯器翻譯）
